state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`: Stages 9 and 10 are done, and Stage 11 is in progress.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv render --website` writes the website's rulebook: `website/src/data/rules.json` and every page under `website/src/content/docs/docs/rules/` except the handwritten `index.mdx` (`tools/nv/renderers/website-rules.ts`). It reads `data/rules/`, the prose under `docs/rules/<topic>/`, and `website/config/rule-sections.mjs`. Over an adapter rulebook built from `data/rules/`, its output was byte-identical to the old `sync-rules.mjs` apart from the marker line. A renderer can now own a directory (`Renderer.owns` in `tools/nv/lib/render.ts`): `render` deletes a file there that it no longer writes, and `render --check` names it. The plain `bun nv render --check`, which CI's docs job runs, covers the website pages too. `website/scripts/sync-rules.mjs` is deleted. `npm run sync:render` in `website/` runs the render.

`bun nv audit ci` still exits 1, and the Stage 11 check is red. This is an open item, not a regression. The only thing it still names is `website/scripts/sync-core.mjs`.

next.title: the Core pages of `bun nv render --website`

items.text: **Port `sync-core.mjs` to a `website-core` renderer** -- `website/scripts/sync-core.mjs:48` writes `website/src/data/core.json` and the tool-owned `.mdx` stubs under `website/src/content/docs/docs/core/`. Its member rows come from tables, which are in `data/spec/core-members.json`. But `website/scripts/lib/spec.mjs:284` also reads prose the records do not carry: each class's summary, the `Enums:` and `Constants:` lines, and the bullet rosters. Before porting, decide where each of those comes from: `nvs meta --json` (`website/scripts/lib/meta.mjs:1`), `data/reference/core/<Class>.json`'s `summary`, or a new record field. Note that a stub is only rewritten while it still says `draft: true`, so `Renderer.owns` (`tools/nv/lib/render.ts:21`) cannot own that directory. Diff `core.json` against what the script writes before deleting it.

**Delete `sync-core.mjs` and its `lib/` helpers** -- point `website/package.json:15` (`sync`, `sync:core`) at `bun nv render --website`. Then `tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts:149` finds nothing and `bun nv audit ci` exits 0.

backlog: The website's `tmLanguage` is rendered from the editor's grammar, or a reason in the grammar's record says why both stay. The goal's Stage 11 bullet `The website.` owns this.

`nv verify` does not run `bun nv render --check`, so a rule edit that leaves the website pages stale fails only in CI. The playbook bullet `Editing a rule fragment leaves the website's copy of it stale` covers this.
`tools/check-links.py:73` still says `npm run sync:rules`. Stage 12 deletes the file.
